verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a SaaS support platform, but the evidence pack documents no first-party bulk export, export file formats, or offboarding and migration path. The general API (pylon-docs-31) and the MCP server (pylon-docs-37) for reading data are only developer building blocks a user could use to build their own export, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
